[Audit C13] Data pipeline provenance and runtime caches

[Parity] First-divergence pipeline: MESA 26.4.1 per-step state and solver dumps, and flexmesa trace --compare

[Audit C3] star_job init departures: restart flag for staged models, initial_y after load, set_initial_dt, remaining relax stand-ins
[Audit D1] Port GYRE (pulsation code bundled with MESA)
[Audit D2] Port ADIPLS (adiabatic pulsation code bundled with MESA)
[Audit D3] Port STELLA (radiative-transfer code bundled with MESA), after all test-suite cases pass
[Audit E1] Plotting as we go: a pgstar and pgbinary replacement built on history and profile output
[Audit E2] Generated progress dashboard in README and docs: port coverage by module, verification status, test coverage, issues and PRs
